name: AI Chatbot by Botami – Smart ChatGPT Assistant for Customer Support & Lead Generation
author: botami2025

sections.description:
Botami AI Chatbot brings the power of ChatGPT to your WordPress website. Deliver instant, intelligent customer support, capture qualified leads, and increase sales with a beautiful, customizable chatbot that works 24/7.

Perfect for businesses, online stores, SaaS platforms, and service providers who want to automate customer interactions while maintaining a personal touch.

Why Choose Botami?

✓ Quick Setup – Get your AI chatbot live in under 5 minutes
✓ No Coding Required – Simple dashboard configuration
✓ ChatGPT Powered – Advanced AI that understands context and intent
✓ Lead Capture – Automatically collect and qualify visitor information
✓ 24/7 Availability – Never miss a customer inquiry again
✓ Multilingual – Communicate in any language automatically
✓ GDPR Compliant – Privacy-first design with full data control
✓ Mobile Optimized – Perfect experience on all devices

Core Features

Smart Conversations
– Natural language understanding powered by ChatGPT
– Context-aware responses for accurate answers
– Intelligent conversation flow
– Automatic language detection

Lead Generation
– Capture visitor contact information
– Qualify leads with smart questions
– Email notifications for new leads
– Export lead data anytime

Full Customization
– Match your brand colors and style
– Custom welcome messages
– Personalized avatar and bot name
– Position control (bottom right, left, etc.)

Easy Management
– Simple WordPress admin panel
– Chat history and analytics
– Page-level chatbot control
– URL exclusion options

Performance & Security
– Lightweight code for fast loading
– GDPR and privacy compliant
– Secure data handling
– Compatible with all caching plugins

Premium Features

Upgrade to unlock advanced capabilities:

  • Knowledge Base Training – Upload PDFs and connect URLs to train your bot
  • Advanced Analytics – Track conversations, user satisfaction, and conversion rates
  • Custom Branding – Remove “Powered by Botami” and add your logo
  • Priority Support – Get help from our team within 24 hours
  • Chat Transcripts – Download full conversation histories
  • API Access – Integrate with your CRM and tools

Upgrade to Premium

Perfect For

  • E-commerce Stores – Answer product questions, guide purchases, reduce cart abandonment
  • SaaS Websites – Qualify leads, explain features, assist with onboarding
  • Service Businesses – Book appointments, answer FAQs, collect inquiries
  • Support Teams – Deflect repetitive questions, provide instant help
  • Educational Sites – Guide students, answer course questions, enrollment assistance

Works With

  • ✓ WooCommerce
  • ✓ Elementor
  • ✓ Gutenberg
  • ✓ Divi Builder
  • ✓ Contact Form 7
  • ✓ All major WordPress themes
  • ✓ WP Rocket and caching plugins
  • ✓ Cloudflare and CDNs

What Users Say

“Reduced our support tickets by 40% in the first month!” – Sarah M.
“Easy to set up and the AI responses are surprisingly accurate.” – John D.
“Best investment for our e-commerce store. Customers love the instant help.” – Lisa K.

Get Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Get your free API key from Botami.ai
  3. Paste the API key in Settings > Botami Chatbot
  4. Customize colors and messages
  5. Your AI chatbot is live!

Free Plan Available – Start with our free tier and upgrade when you grow.

Privacy & Data Security

Botami takes your privacy seriously:

What We Collect
– Chat conversations (optional, can be disabled)
– Visitor messages and bot responses
– Lead information if provided by visitors (name, email)
– Basic usage analytics for service improvement

What We Don’t Do
– We never sell or share your data with third parties
– No tracking cookies without consent
– No personal data collection without explicit visitor interaction
– No data retention beyond what you configure

Your Control
– Enable/disable chat history storage
– Delete all data with one click on uninstall
– Export conversation data anytime
– Full GDPR, CCPA, and privacy law compliance

Security
– All data transmitted via secure HTTPS
– Encrypted storage in your WordPress database
– Regular security audits and updates
– API communication over SSL/TLS

For complete details, visit our Privacy Policy

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the Botami AI service to provide chatbot functionality:

Botami API
– Service URL: api.botami.ai
– Purpose: Process chat messages and generate AI responses
– Data transmitted: User messages, conversation context
– Privacy: Privacy Policy | Terms of Service

Third-Party Libraries Included

This plugin includes the following open-source libraries (bundled, no external calls):

  • Alpine.js (v3.x) – MIT License
    Lightweight JavaScript framework for interactive UI components

  • Flowbite – MIT License
    Modern UI component library for interface elements

  • Tailwind CSS (v2.2.19) – MIT License
    Utility-first CSS framework for styling

  • create-file-list – MIT License
    Utility for file handling in chat attachments

All libraries are minified and included locally. No external CDN calls are made.

Support & Documentation

Free Support
– Comprehensive documentation at Botami.ai/docs
– Community forum for questions and tips
– Video tutorials and setup guides

Premium Support
– Priority email support (24-hour response)
– Live chat assistance
– Custom integration help
– Dedicated account manager (Enterprise)

Resources
– Documentation: botami.ai/docs
– Support: botami.ai/support
– Report bugs: botami.ai/support

Requirements
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.4 or higher
– HTTPS-enabled website (recommended)
– Botami API key (free signup)

About Botami

Botami is a leading AI chatbot platform designed specifically for WordPress websites. Our mission is to make advanced AI technology accessible to every website owner, helping businesses automate support, capture leads, and improve customer experience.

Trusted by thousands of websites worldwide, Botami combines cutting-edge ChatGPT technology with WordPress simplicity.

Visit Botami.ai to learn more.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Botami AI Chatbot”
  4. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  5. Navigate to Settings > Botami Chatbot
  6. Get your free API key from Botami.ai
  7. Enter the API key and save
  8. Customize your chatbot appearance and messages
  9. Done! Your AI chatbot is now live

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Follow steps 5-9 from automatic installation

First-Time Configuration

After activation, visit Settings > Botami Chatbot to configure:

  • API Key: Required to connect to Botami AI service
  • Welcome Message: First message visitors see
  • Bot Name: Give your chatbot a friendly name
  • Colors: Match your website’s branding
  • Position: Choose where the chat widget appears
  • Page Settings: Enable/disable on specific pages
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, you need a Botami API key to use this plugin. Sign up for free at Botami.ai and get your API key instantly. The free tier includes everything you need to get started.

Is the plugin really free?

Yes! The plugin is 100% free to download and use. Botami offers a free tier for API usage that’s perfect for small to medium websites. Premium plans are available if you need advanced features like custom knowledge bases or higher usage limits.

How does the AI chatbot work?

The chatbot uses advanced ChatGPT technology to understand visitor questions and provide intelligent, contextual answers. It learns from your website content and can be trained on your specific documentation in the premium version.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Absolutely. Botami is designed with privacy-first principles. All data is processed securely, stored encrypted, and you maintain full control. Visitors can request data deletion at any time, and the plugin complies with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations.

Can I customize the chatbot appearance?

Yes! You can fully customize:
– Widget colors (background, text, buttons)
– Bot avatar and name
– Welcome and initial messages
– Widget position and size
– Language and tone
– Display rules per page/URL

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, the chatbot is fully responsive and optimized for all devices – smartphones, tablets, and desktops. It’s built with mobile-first design principles and won’t affect your Core Web Vitals scores.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is extremely lightweight (less than 50KB) and loads asynchronously. It’s optimized for performance and compatible with all major caching plugins like WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, and WP Super Cache.

Can the chatbot speak multiple languages?

Yes! The AI automatically detects the visitor’s language and responds accordingly. It supports 50+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, and more.

Can I train the chatbot on my own content?

With the Premium plan, you can upload PDFs, documentation, FAQs, and connect private URLs to create a custom knowledge base. The AI will learn from your content and provide more accurate, brand-specific answers.

What happens to chat conversations?

Chat conversations are stored locally in your WordPress database (optional, can be disabled). You can view chat history, export conversations, and delete data anytime from your admin panel.

Does it integrate with CRM or email marketing tools?

Premium users get API access to integrate with tools like HubSpot, Mailchimp, Salesforce, and more. Lead information can be automatically synced to your preferred platform.

Can I hide the chatbot on specific pages?

Yes, you have full control. You can enable/disable the chatbot on specific pages, posts, categories, or use URL patterns to exclude certain sections of your site.

What kind of support do you offer?

Free users get access to our documentation and community forum. Premium users receive priority email support with responses within 24 hours, plus access to live chat support.

How do I upgrade to Premium?

Visit Botami.ai to view plans and upgrade. Premium unlocks advanced features like knowledge base training, custom branding, analytics, and priority support.
